policy: Bundle budget of the production frontend, checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (CI static shard). KB = 1,000 bytes. Raising a value = a change of this file in the branch, with a `history` entry and a reason, approved by the BA at the merge. Every value needs a reason; the script refuses the file otherwise.

initialJsGzip.reason: Interim (B1). Measured on feature/v107-wp9a (747,042 B, entry chunk + static import closure, gzip level 9 per file) + 36,000 B allowance for the 1.0.7 work packages that land before WP9c. Lowered by WP9c and WP9d (final: 370,000 B, WP9d must land at 330,000 B or less).

initialJsRaw.reason: Interim (B2). Measured 2,652,417 B + 110,000 B allowance for WP2 to WP8 and WP13. Final: 1,300,000 B (WP9d).
